clips.title: The story
paras: Desperate Prayer is a rite of passage for dwarven priests coming of age in Ironforge. Dispatched by High Priest Rohan, acolytes journey through the Deeprun Tram to Stormwind to continue their training under High Priestess Laurena. Reaching the grand Cathedral of Light marks an initiate's transition into deeper mysteries of healing and survival.

Within the stone vaults of Ironforge's Mystic Ward, High Priest Rohan oversees dwarven initiates dedicated to the Holy Light. When an acolyte demonstrates sufficient discipline and faith, Rohan directs them southwest to the human kingdom of Stormwind. Human and dwarven clerics maintain close spiritual bonds, and advanced theological instruction is centralized in the grand halls of Stormwind City.

Upon arriving via the subterranean Deeprun Tram, acolytes ascend to the Cathedral Square. There, within the majestic Cathedral of Light, High Priestess Laurena tests candidates on behalf of the Church. Her instruction focuses on the desperate appeals a priest must make in the crucible of battle—pleas for divine intervention when physical endurance fails and death looms near.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You're needed in Stormwind, friend. The High Priestess there, Laurena, says it's time for you to prove you're worthy of the next level of your training. Don't waste too much time finding your way there. You can find her in the Cathedral of Light in the center of the city. Give her my regards, and prove how worthy you are of such a calling. The Light be with you, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I'm glad you've arrived, friend. There are many things we will have to discuss, but more importantly is your training in the ways of the Light.
There are lessons all servants of the Light must learn. If you are ready, we'll begin discussing some of those now.
